news.title: The art and science of ‘A Christmas Carol’
news.summary_en: The ISU Theatre's new adaptation of "A Christmas Carol" features more than 80 handcrafted puppets, highlighting the intersection of art and science as students draw on design, engineering and problem-solving skills to turn imagination into movement.

news.title: Favorable climate helped corn spread across Americas and hybridize in highlands
news.summary_en: An unusually wet period in the Mexican highlands may have helped ancient corn mix with a higher-altitude variety to create the hybrid that’s the genetic ancestor of most modern versions of the crop, new research led by an Iowa State University anthropologist shows.
